commit.message:
feat: add custom usernames and avatars to local profiles

- Add username and avatar editing to account settings on Android and web.
- Display the saved profile in the sidebar with a default name and avatar.
- Persist account profiles locally on each platform.

feat: keep long conversations running with context compaction

- Add rolling summaries for each conversation branch and recover from context overflow while preserving original history.
- Split oversized PDF and modern Office attachments into batches and continue the current reply.
- Verify overflow recovery, document splitting, and cancellation with mocked API requests.
- Set the app version to 0.5.0 and the Android version code to 14.

feat: add in-app updates to Android

- Check the latest GitHub release from Android settings and show the available version and download progress.
- Verify the downloaded APK and keep it available for installation retries.
- Open the system installer and resume after the user grants permission to install from this source.

feat: add predictive back navigation to Android

- Delegate return to the launcher and chat to Android when there is no in-app destination, while preserving WebView history.
- Share horizontal settings transitions between ordinary navigation and predictive back across nested pages.
- Preview image dismissal with gesture-driven movement, scaling, and background reveal.

feat: add Android image cropping and release v0.4.0

- Add cropping for draft and sent images with zoom, rotation, and reset.
- Support HEIC photo selection and match Android crop sizing and WebP output.
- Set the application version to 0.4.0 and Android version code to 13.

fix: handle oversized images in new and historical chat messages

- Prepare size-limited WebP uploads while keeping the original image for local display and storage.
- Recover rejected image attachments in new messages and historical context.
- Bump the Android and package versions to 0.3.5.

fix: recover chat saves after IndexedDB connections close

- Reopen stale IndexedDB connections and retry transaction creation once.
- Verify on Android that a chat survives a cold start after an interrupted database connection.

fix: support large attachments and the full output budget

- Retry through the base Messages API when DeepSeek rejects an extended request at 32K input tokens.
- Request the official 384K output limit for chat responses.
- Bump the Android and package versions to 0.3.4.

fix: align Android navigation bar and drawer rendering

- Clear the drawer transform and backdrop when the sidebar closes.
- Keep controls above three-button navigation while drawing the composer shadow behind it.
- Cover drawer settling and navigation insets in the Android onboarding regression.
- Bump the Android and web release version to 0.3.3.

fix: support Android 10 and its bundled WebView

- Adapt system bars, keyboard insets, and browser layout for API 29.
- Target WebView 74 and add fallbacks for region names, layout, and binary reads.
- Add an emulator regression for API key setup, visible chat, streaming, and restart.
- Bump the Android and web release version to 0.3.2.

perf: accelerate large history imports for Android 0.3.1

- Move history archive parsing and staged database writes to a worker, with a fallback for environments that cannot start it.
- Overlap parsing and batch writes, streamline ZIP decoding and validation, and reduce temporary allocations when converting long sessions.
- Bump the web and Android release version to 0.3.1.

perf: speed up history imports and conversation loading

- Batch archive writes and switch history stores atomically after validation, with resumable cleanup of retired records.
- Stream ZIP entries more efficiently and report import progress and estimated read time.
- Render recent messages first and limit the sidebar to rows near the viewport.
chore: prepare Android release 0.3.0

fix: keep Android release signing secrets out of Git

- Stop tracking the release keystore and ignore the local signing files.
- Load release passwords from a local Gradle properties file.

feat: vary Android welcome messages across new chats

Use the observed Chinese and English greetings on Android. Choose a greeting when the welcome screen mounts and retain it while the current screen is in use.

fix: show browsed sources in the Android reading panel

- Derive each reading step's sources from successful results using the fetched URLs and shared metadata.
- Open the existing Android source sheet with a browsed-results title from the reading step.

fix: open service agreements and FAQ from Android settings

- Open the app policies and SDK sharing list in the app browser.
- Open the official FAQ directly and keep the API help and privacy policy accessible from their relevant settings.

fix: open Android markdown links in the app browser

- Use the same isolated browser for Android markdown links and search sources.
- Show the current page title in the browser toolbar and restore it with navigation state.
chore: ignore local agent instructions

fix: restore Android chat layout after API key setup

- Use a compatible viewport height for the API key screen and chat layout.
- Bind visual viewport updates when onboarding first mounts the chat.
- Bump the Android and web release versions to 0.2.2.
chore: prepare Android release 0.2.1

perf: improve Android chat rendering and drawer gesture responsiveness

- Match the reference drawer's drag distance, fling decisions, and release timing.
- Move streaming Markdown parsing off the main thread and reuse unchanged blocks.
- Let WebView handle vertical panning and avoid redundant chat layout and sidebar updates.
chore: prepare Android release 0.2.0

fix: remove unavailable Android account controls

- Remove the disabled data optimization switch because it cannot change API data handling.
- Remove the shared links placeholder because the API does not provide share management.

fix: preview and save Android chat images

Open local images from conversation history in a full-screen viewer. Save the original bytes to the Android photo library and publish the new image only after the write succeeds.

fix: confirm Android chat pin and unpin actions

Show the selection count and ask for confirmation before changing the selected conversations. Keep the selection available when the confirmation is dismissed.

fix: keep active replies running when history imports fail

Stage and validate the entire archive before freezing chat changes and stopping active replies. A rejected archive leaves both the current history and its streams intact.

fix: restore Android history archive import and export

- Buffer ZIP reads and show the import status, result count, and errors.
- Open the Android document picker with the requested file type.
- Generate archives before opening the device save dialog.
- Bump the web and Android release version to 0.1.2.
chore: prepare Android release 0.1.1

fix: support Android 11 and its bundled WebView

- Lower the Android minimum SDK to API 30 and document the tested platform.
- Use the legacy Android back callback on API 30–32.
- Target Chromium 83 in the frontend build and polyfill missing JavaScript APIs.

build: configure dedicated release signing keystore

Add dedicated release keystore and configure automatic release signing in Gradle.

docs: add centered header badges and remove feature section

- Center header with badges and release download link

- Remove core features section and streamline user setup flow

docs: rewrite readme and relicense project under GPL-3.0

- Rewrite Chinese README with centered badges, download links, and setup guides

- Switch project license to GPL-3.0 while preserving upstream MIT attribution

- Update package metadata and remove redundant README.zh-CN.md

feat: reproduce Android photo selection interactions

- Keep selected photos in the panel with animated previews and quick prompts
- Prefetch accessible recent photos without blocking the interface
- Align attachment action icons with the Android reference
fix: align Android composer above the keyboard
chore: rename Android package and application

fix: match Android search citations and source pages

- Show citations and search results in a draggable Android sheet
- Open source pages in an isolated native browser

fix: match Android thinking transitions and scrolling

- Render the moving highlight and scrolling preview for long reasoning
- Animate disclosure changes and pause following when reasoning is expanded

fix: align Android conversation spacing and message controls

- Match message bubble spacing and expose editing from the bubble
- Adjust the composer inset and Android disclaimer text

fix: preserve Android voice mode during transcription

- Keep the recording overlay visible while transcription is pending
- Retain voice mode across conversations and show the matching empty result
